change_summary: Ran a runtime-only monkeypatch of `risk_engine.enrich_signals()` and `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` so each signal carried per-day market and sector breadth fields (`sector_above200_breadth`, `sector_positive_momentum_breadth`, `sector_breakout_breadth`, plus market equivalents). Screened six breakout-only sizing variants across the deterministic late / mid / old OHLCV snapshots: two sector narrow-leadership shapes (`above200 high + sector momentum low + sector breakout scarce`) at `0.0x/0.25x`, and two market-vs-sector relative-momentum gap variants at `0.0x/0.25x`. No repository trading code was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `quant/risk_engine.py` + `quant/portfolio_engine.py` sizing path (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: This new participation proxy failed to unlock present-tense edge. Every screened sector-relative variant stayed a strict null in both the late-strong and mid-weak windows; only the oldest weak window improved modestly. The best variant (`sec_nlb_strict_25`) reduced old-window drawdown (`9.03% -> 8.00%`) and lifted EV (`0.0109 -> 0.0165`), but there was still no evidence that sector participation context improves the current dominant tape or even the intermediate weak-bull tape.

hypothesis: If the whole-universe participation-state branch was still too coarse, then a genuinely different proxy in the same breakout-health family should work better: de-risk `breakout_long` only when the stock's own sector shows narrow or weak participation before entry. A valid sector-relative context signal should improve at least the mid/old snapshots while finally creating some present-tense value in the late strong snapshot.
next_retry_requires: Do not keep sweeping nearby sector breadth thresholds or 0x/0.25x deployment shapes by default

If breakout-health work is revisited again, require a richer context source than sector breadth alone, such as sector-relative leadership persistence over time, event context, or fresh forward data that creates a new primary-window test
Prefer another unblocked alpha branch over more participation-breadth-only breakout sizing variants unless new evidence appears
notes: This remained a single-causal-variable experiment: only the breakout sleeve's pre-entry risk budget changed, using sector-relative participation context instead of whole-universe participation context. Entries, exits, ranking, and the current accepted cohort rules stayed unchanged.
rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 promotion criteria. This was a genuinely different participation proxy than `exp-20260423-002/003`, but it still produced no primary-window improvement and no mid-window gain. Sector-relative breadth alone is therefore not enough to promote breakout-health sizing into repo logic.
